title: From a family farm to soil science.
body: Raised on a farm in southern Brazil, Márcio brings agricultural experience to research on soil management in tropical and temperate environments. His work connects soil health assessment with agricultural productivity and natural resource stewardship.

employment.title: University of Florida
employment.body: Assistant Professor of Tropical Soils. Department of Soil, Water, and Ecosystem Sciences.

academic_body: Doctoral research at Cornell University during 2017–2018, followed by research and teaching at UF.

source_link.label: Career and education: UF/IFAS faculty feature

achievements_body: His research portfolio includes the development of SHAPE soil health scoring and benchmarking approaches, with applications to soil organic carbon and other dynamic indicators.
